title: Counterfeit-Banknote Authentication Program
subtitle: Luck Lab, Center for Mind & Brain
body: I contributed eye-tracking and biobehavioral research expertise to an international study of counterfeit banknote identification for the US Federal Reserve and the central banks of Canada, England and Australia.
This is the line my current research continues: adversarial artifacts, human and machine detectors, and the measured gap between them.
note: First-hand research contribution. No authorship or acknowledgment in Scientific Reports 12:2076 is claimed.
